# Course-supplied files

- `viewer.html`: unchanged `week5/viewer/index.html` from the 2026-09-30 download of `https://giggleliu.github.io/AMAT5315-2026Fall/downloads/week5-resources.zip`.
- `course-check`: unchanged `week5/checker/check` from that archive. Its `parents[2]` lookup resolves the exercise repository; it reads `week5/inputs` and checks the stated public gates. Run `.venv/bin/python vendor/course-check .` from week5.
- `enzyme-setup-SKILL.md`: downloaded from `https://giggleliu.github.io/AMAT5315-2026Fall/downloads/enzyme-setup/SKILL.md`; installed unchanged in the repository's `.agents/skills/enzyme-setup/`.

These are supporting materials, not the student's solver. `src/`, tests and scripts were implemented locally from the learning sheet; plots use new Rust/JAX outputs. No instructor result array or reference image was used as a generated result.
